program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((ones (filter (lambda (cell) (= 1 (third cell))) (grid-cells g)))
                (min-r (min-list (map fst ones)))
                (max-r (max-list (map fst ones)))
                (mid (/ (+ min-r max-r) 2)))
           (map-grid g (lambda (r c v) (if (and (= v 1) (> r mid)) 2 v))))))
